objective: Separate Taiwan public securities-lending quote, execution, balance and true-inventory evidence so one disclosure cannot be misused as all four borrow-economics objects.

officialEvidence.evidence: Internet/computer disclosure is required for fixed-rate executed quantity plus unexecuted lend/borrow totals and for competitive-bid executions plus best-five lend/borrow rate/quantity and totals.
Borrowing is explicitly not equivalent to short selling; borrowed securities can support hedging, arbitrage, loan returns and other uses.
Public historical transaction inquiry exposes traded-date, transaction-type and stock filters with HTML/CSV download controls; exact stable programmatic parameter contract remains unfrozen.
Public balance inquiry exposes historical date/category query and CSV download and states data availability since 2004-11-22.

End-of-day SBL balance product is generated at 20:30 and contains prior balance, current borrowing, returns, current balance, close and market value; it does not provide live quote-book depth or true lendable inventory.
